# Historical names for the generic bookmark tank, SPAA, SP artillery and tank destroyer
# designs. Every name is the live country equipment localisation string for the matching
# legacy tier, recorded with file and line in LogDocs/Tank_Designer/data/Tank_Naming_Preset_Manifest.json.
# Recipes are copied verbatim from the generic blocks in CWIC_tank_designer_effects.txt, so
# these guards rename a starting design without altering a single stat. Each sets the generic
# block's own flag, which is what suppresses the generic fallback.

cwic_create_national_heavy_tank_artillery_chassis_1_variants = {
	# ADR: ADR_heavy_sp_artillery_equipment_1 in ADR_equipment_l_english .yml:213
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_dlc = "No Step Back"
			tag = ADR
			has_tech = nsb_heavy_tanks0
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cwic_starting_heavy_tank_artillery_chassis_1_created }
		}
		create_equipment_variant = {
			name = "Hummel"
			type = heavy_tank_artillery_chassis_1
			allow_without_tech = yes
			parent_version = 0
			mark_older_equipment_obsolete = yes
			upgrades = { tank_engine_upgrade = 0 tank_armor_upgrade = 0 }
			modules = {
				main_armament_slot = tank_low_p_cannon0
				turret_type_slot = heavy_open_gun
				suspension_type_slot = Bogie_0
				armor_type_slot = Armor_0_W
				engine_type_slot = Petrol_0
				tank_special_slot_1 = ap_0p
				tank_special_slot_2 = tank_he_0p
			}
			icon = "GFX_ADR_heavy_sp_artillery_1_medium"
		}
		set_country_flag = cwic_starting_heavy_tank_artillery_chassis_1_created
	}
